A 28� diameter, single circle of ice is discovered on Cranberry Creek by Myra Serfass while she was out walking her dog behind her house.

None of the professors in the physics department a nearby East Stroudsberg University had ever heard of such a phenomenon, but hazarded a guess that the circle was created by an eddy in the slow moving water in the creek. A correspondent with the local paper, Jim Rourke, suggested that the circle was the result of a spring beneath the spot where the circle formed because the ice in the circle was much whiter than the surrounding ice due to the air bubbles in the fresh spring water bubbling up. Neither explanation was tested, nor has the circle been seen (before or) since.

Eyewitness report only.

Crop type: ice

Source: “Ice Formation’s Perfection Cries Out For an Explanation”, “Explanation for Creek Ice Circle”, Pocono Summit Record, Feb. 1993; “Rings of Ice”, Fortean Times No.74 Apr-May 1994

Sabine Pass, Jefferson County (November 30, 2005)

A single 40� diameter circle found in reeds and marsh grass along Texas Highway 87. The RDF circle was flattened all in one direction, much like the Mendon, NY reeds circle reported in October; it was not swirled.

A wire fence ran through the circle, and the plants were pushed up against it.

The circle was very difficult to access because the area surrounding it was under 1-2 feet of standing water, and being in the marsh, there were fears of alligators and water snakes.

Although basic, I left this fairly rough looking circle feeling as though Id witnessed something of importance. f6bfd1617a6f.desc:
After the news received me of a new formation, discovered by Robbert again, I was not directly in the opportunity to visit the field. We have had a few grass formations so far and, to be honoust, we are hoping for a formation in crops in the near future.
Because I had to be in the area for work I decided to visit the formation on my way home. When I parked my car I noticed an elderly couple making pictures at some distance from where I was standing.

All the circles were laid anti clockwise. There were 9 in total in 3 different diameters;
3 bigger ones, 3 medium sized ones and 3 small circles. One of the circles had a tuft in the centre.
Was there a hidden meaning in this?

3 x 3 x 3 = 27

3 + 3 + 3 = 9

27 - 9 = 18

The formation was formed in the night of 18th- 19th of June.
Maybe we regocnize the trinity in this and has this circle something to do with religion.
Mabe Robbert will publish more on the meaning of this formation on his website.

The grass was mixed with lots of weeds and looked like it was laid down with an enormous force. I noticed a lot of bend nodes which can also be found in grass that was laid down by the wind. At a closer look I noticed that the wax coating of the stems were damaged. 

Because the rain came in really quickly I decided to go home. A thunderstorm broke loose and the elderly couple slipped off a slope and ended in the ditch. I wanted to go and help them but they were already on their feet again. I wondered who they had been. At home I took a look at the pictures I had taken but I couldn't see the people on any of them, and they shoul have been. A strange phenomenon I experienced more this season. Maybe these people hold the key and will they become important in the near future.

Sjaak Damen.
